explanation: Sweep sorted event endpoints, counting active intervals. Process starts before finishes at an equal time because this contract counts touching endpoints as overlapping. The largest active count is the answer.
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract.
correctness: Between consecutive endpoints, the active count changes only at starts and finishes. Sorting equal-time starts before finishes counts all closed intervals that contain that shared endpoint. The largest count seen during the sweep is exactly the maximum overlap.
walkthrough: Events [1,2], [2,3] and [2,2] all contain time 2. Processing their starts before the finishes at 2 raises the active count to three.
edgeCases: A zero-length event still contains its endpoint.
An empty event list has maximum overlap zero.
